messages.subject: Executive interest | Energy transition, stakeholder strategy and regional growth
messages.body:
Dear Banpu Group Talent Team,

Banpu Power is a strong fit for my background because my executive experience sits directly between resource operations, power transition and institutional delivery.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. I lead government and regulatory engagement, ESG coordination, social performance, corporate affairs and senior stakeholder strategy across a major industrial operation.

My recent work includes governance and stakeholder support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, alongside carbon-data readiness based on physical operating records. I also coordinate permits, inspections, official engagements, community priorities and cross-functional corrective actions. This gives me an operating-side perspective on the issues that shape power growth: regulation, social licence, evidence, reputation and execution discipline.

I would welcome consideration for Banpu Power or wider Banpu Group mandates in External Affairs, ESG, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships, Country Leadership or regional stakeholder strategy. I am open to Thailand, ASEAN and international assignments and have a 30-day notice period.

I have attached a Banpu Power-focused executive CV for review and would value a discussion with the relevant senior talent or business leader.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
